# Story 2.1: Generate Day Plan with Quick and HQ Planning

Status: done

<!-- Generated by BMAD 6.8 create-story workflow on 2026-07-26. -->

## Story

As a travel planner,
I want to see a usable day plan quickly while a higher-quality version continues in the background,
so that I can inspect the trip immediately and adopt a better version when it is ready.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Given Story 2.0 submits a valid `PlanGenerateRequest`, when the user selects `开始规划`, then the authenticated endpoint returns `plan_id`, `plan_job_id`, and `sse_url`. A successful job emits `started → freeze → selected_anchor → quota → candidates → place → validate → persist → done`; a failed job emits a valid prefix followed by `failed`. Events include trace context and heartbeats, and every job reaches exactly one terminal state.
2. Given the Picker contains selected L3 POIs, when Quick planning runs, then every selected item is treated as `selected_required` and is placed before ordinary candidates; an item blocked by a hard constraint is preserved as `unresolved_required` with an explanation instead of being silently dropped or downgraded. L2 remains a grouping/cluster input and is never a selected object.
3. Given `pace=tight|comfortable`, when Quick builds each day, then it uses 2-hour or 4-hour base slots respectively, applies the 2.5-hour duration threshold, respects wake/morning start and first/last-day travel windows, prefers feasible POIs in the same L1/L2 area, and produces deterministic output for identical inputs and configuration.
4. Given `candidate_items` or an empty selection, when Planner fills available capacity, then optional candidates are deduplicated by canonical AMap POI, retain source attribution/quality/reason metadata, and are placed only when feasible; unused candidates remain available in the plan candidate page/drawer. Empty selection uses AnchorPool and then a trustworthy built-in city fallback; if no feasible POI exists, Planner leaves a free slot and never fabricates a POI.
5. Given server-resolved inspiration evidence implies dawn, sunset, night, night-market, reservation, or ticket timing, when Planner assigns slots, then an evidence-backed constraint carries an optional date, local start/end window, timezone, source/evidence reference, and quality grade. The constraint takes precedence over ordinary candidates and the Agent chooses a feasible day/time when no date is explicit. No standalone Confirm toggle is introduced, and ordinary placement cannot overwrite a hard-time window.
6. Given per-date hotels and luggage data, when Planner builds the plan, then only explicitly selected hotels populate `hotel_slot`; `leave_blank=true` remains blank. Breakfast stays hotel child data. Hotel location and luggage handling may influence early/late radius, clustering, and hotel-change buffers, but `near_hotel` never overrides hard constraints and Planner never silently chooses a hotel.
7. Given seed autoplace is enabled, when candidates are evaluated, then the quota is `ceil(alpha * S_left)`, only AMap-verified POIs are auto-placed, hard conflicts are not placed, soft conflicts become warnings, and seed slots store `origin=ai_seed`. The user can undo the seed result for 5-8 seconds and reset only seed-origin placements without removing selected-required anchors or hand changes.
8. Given `smart_planning=true`, when Quick reaches a usable terminal result, then the server starts exactly one idempotent HQ job and includes `hq_job_id` in the Quick `done` event and persisted plan summary; the client does not issue a second start request. HQ `running|done|failed` is observable; failure leaves Quick usable, completion can be previewed, and `切换-采用` atomically promotes the HQ version while preserving both versions until adoption succeeds. `/plan/hq/start` is reserved for an explicit start/retry when smart planning was off or a prior HQ job failed.
9. Given the plan screen renders, when the user inspects a day, then it shows D1...Dn, stable 2h/4h slots, explicit hotel/free/unresolved states, HQ status, seed undo/reset, and a candidate entry. For an empty slot, Story 2.1 supports only revision-checked `fill_empty_slot_with_candidate` and `set_free_activity` operations; candidate/AI/AMap results feed the former. General replacement, retiming, movement, or deletion remains Story 2.2. User-facing copy says “计划/正在规划” and never exposes “骨架”, `must_go`, or “必去”.
10. Given Story 2.1 changes plan contracts and persistence, when implementation is complete, then OpenAPI remains the API SSOT, generated types and Prisma artifacts are regenerated, protected plan resources enforce user ownership, idempotency is atomic, SSE timers/jobs are cleaned up after disconnect/terminal state, and all automated/visual verification listed in this story passes.

## Scope Exclusions

- Story 2.2 owns general long-press editing, drag/drop, retiming, cross-day movement, full undo history, and arbitrary slot mutation UX.
- Story 2.1 owns only filling an empty slot from a returned candidate and marking an empty slot as free activity; these operations cannot target occupied slots.
- Story 2.3 owns the full feasibility dashboard and one-click fix workflow. Story 2.1 still must prevent hard-conflict placement and return typed warnings/unresolved items.
- Story 2.4 owns itinerary image export.
- Multi-city `transport_slot`, hotel-change auto-replanning/history snapshots, and a full embedded map search are Post-MVP compatibility concerns.
- Cross-user Xiaohongshu media/content deduplication is not part of Planner. Keep it in deferred ingest/storage work.
- Do not reintroduce BYOK, a manual ticket row, a special-time toggle, an L2 selection control, or a user-facing must-go control.

## Dev Notes

### Current State

- Story 2.0 is complete and sends the aligned `PlanGenerateRequest` from `apps/mobile/src/planner/PlannerScreen.tsx`.
- `/plan/generate` in `apps/server/src/routes/plan.ts` currently validates/authenticates, creates random IDs, and returns an ACK; it does not persist or generate a plan.
- `/sse/plan/:jobId` currently emits mock `started/anchor/cluster/validate/persist/done` events. Its recursive timeout survives disconnect; Story 2.1 replaces this lifecycle.
- OpenAPI already sketches HQ endpoints, but they use incomplete inline shapes and have no implementation.
- Prisma has Plan/PlanDay/PlanSlot/SlotCandidate foundations, but `PlanPace` is still `slow|normal|fast` and there are no plan jobs, versions, HQ jobs, hotel slots, slot origin, or unresolved-required records.
- CanonicalPOI currently lacks latitude/longitude and verification/quality provenance, while Prisma has no L1Area/L2Group/Membership models. Client-side Xiamen keyword grouping is display-only and must never become Planner authority.
- `PlannerScreen` currently ends with a notice containing `sse_url`; Story 2.1 must transition into an actual plan screen.

### Architecture And Security Guardrails

- `docs/api/openapi.yaml` is the API SSOT. Regenerate `packages/types/src/api-types.ts` after contract changes.
- Server TypeScript uses ESM/NodeNext `.js` import specifiers. Use existing Fastify plugins, `authGuard`, trace IDs, `reply.sendError`, idempotency, rate limits, and SSE conventions.
- Every plan/job/version/slot route must verify the authenticated user's ownership. IDs alone are not authorization.
- Planner request references are untrusted: resolve Inspirations through the authenticated user and verify any supplied POI relationship; resolve hotel/provider references server-side.
- Idempotency must reserve before scheduling work. A check-then-store race is not sufficient for concurrent requests.
- Persist terminal job state so reconnect and process recovery do not depend on an in-memory timer.
- Provider secrets remain server-managed and must not enter responses, logs, analytics, or persisted plan evidence.

### Reuse Before Adding

- Extend `apps/mobile/src/planner/PlannerScreen.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/planner/api.ts`, `apps/server/src/routes/plan.ts`, `apps/server/src/schemas.ts`, and `apps/server/scripts/planner-contract-probe.ts`.
- Reuse Story 2.0 hotel matching, selected/candidate payloads, time-hint derivation, Home/Library data, authenticated shell, error parsing, and analytics wrapper.
- Reuse Plan/PlanDay/PlanSlot/SlotCandidate where compatible. Introduce new entities only for durable concepts absent from the schema.
- Keep algorithmic code separate from Fastify and Prisma so deterministic unit tests do not require network or a live database.
